Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 is already a time expression, so adding 的时候 redundantly says “at the time of ancient times.” [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 城市有才两个学校：城市里只有两所学校，use 只有 before the number to mean “only,” and use 所, the matching measure word for schools. [teacher rule: zhiyou_caiyou]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：有一个叫孟子的男孩子和他的妈妈住在中国，at first mention, introduce the character with both the name and a full noun phrase rather than naming him only in the following sentence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天：他不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes as the referent, so use a pronoun for close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：他很喜欢自己的城市，when the city belongs to the subject of the sentence, 自己的 makes the possessor relationship clear. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
才有 is wrong for “only,” and 两所学校 is the appropriate measure-word phrase.
Under the teacher's first-mention rule, the character should be introduced with his name in the initial full noun phrase.
孟子 was just mentioned and there is no competing male referent, so 他 is required by the teacher's close re-reference rule.
他的城市 is already clear and acceptable here; 自己的 is possible but not required by the teacher's “often use” guideline.
